_help: Describe the data flows of your AI agent system. Use null for 'not known yet': the pack will print an [OPEN] marker and list the question. Never put a client's or person's real data in this file. Allowed values are listed in the _help keys; see examples/dd_harness.json for a filled example. Fields ending in _tr are the Turkish wording used in the Turkish documents (written when KVKK applies); leave null to get an [AÇIK] marker.

controller._help: role: controller | processor | both (towards clients; per activity you can override with activities[].role). country: ISO code, e.g. TR, DE.
controller.name: My firm

scope._help: eu_clients: do EU clients send you files (then a Turkish firm needs the clients' SCCs)? offers_to_eu_data_subjects / monitors_eu_behaviour: Art. 3(2) triggers.

subjects._help: vulnerable: employees, children, patients... contract_party: true only if these people themselves are party to your contract (Art. 6(1)(b) works only for them).
subjects.label: Clients

data._help: kind: ordinary | contact | id_number | financial | special (Art. 9) | criminal (Art. 10) | minor. For criminal data add criminal_type: conviction | proceedings | sanctions_listing | mixed
data.label: Names and contact details

activities._help: source: one or a list of data_subject | client | public | third_party | generated. lawful_basis: 6(1)(a)...6(1)(f). kvkk_basis e.g. m.5/2-e. art9_condition e.g. 9(2)(f). role: controller | processor (if it differs from controller.role). legal_service: true if the activity is the legal advice itself. labels_people: true if it gives people a risk label or score. partners: partner ids. recipients: extra recipients not visible from agents/vendors. eu_offer_related: false if this activity is not part of offering services to people in the EU (Art. 3(2) scope).
activities.name: Main purpose

agents._help: models: vendor ids of the language models; vendors: other vendors the agent sends data to. output: internal | client | court | published. human_review: always | sometimes | never (true/false also accepted). sends: {vendor id: raw | masked | metadata} when this agent sends differently from the vendor default.
agents.name: Agent

vendors._help: role: processor | sub_processor | controller | joint_controller | none. country: ISO code or LOCAL. receives: raw | masked | metadata | none. dpa: signed | accepted_online | available | none. transfer_mechanism: adequacy | dpf | scc | bcr | derogation | none. tier: free | paid | enterprise. parent_country: country of the parent company if different (e.g. US).
vendors.name: Model vendor

storage._help: vendor: id of the vendor hosting it (a LOCAL vendor for your own computer)

_help_partners: partners: [{id, name, country, role: joint_controller | controller | processor, arrangement, service_tr}] for firms you share matters with.

security._help: masking_profile: the Katip masking profile used before cloud calls (e.g. ai, eu, court).

secrecy._help: turkish_lawyer: are you bound by Av.K. m.36? client_regimes: other secrecy rules your clients bring, e.g. § 203 StGB.

ai._help: role: deployer | provider | both. annex_iii: [] if none; areas: employment, credit, insurance, justice, migration, biometric, education, essential_services, law_enforcement
